**Recipe found: Easy Vegetarian Spinach Lasagna** (Allrecipes)
URL: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/229764/easy-vegetarian-spinach-lasagna/

- **Rating:** 4.6 stars (117 ratings, 85 written reviews)
- **Servings:** 6
- **Prep:** 20 mins | **Cook:** 1 hr | **Additional:** 5 mins | **Total:** 1 hr 25 mins

**Ingredients**
- Cooking spray
- Salt and ground black pepper to taste
- 10 oz fresh spinach
- 9 lasagna noodles
- 1 (8 oz) container ricotta cheese
- 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, divided
- 1 large egg, lightly beaten
- 1 pinch ground nutmeg
- 1 pinch dried basil
- 1 cup pasta sauce
- ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese

**Directions**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Spray a 1½-quart casserole dish with cooking spray; set aside.
2. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Boil spinach until wilted and tender, about 2 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon, pressing out excess water; set aside.
3. Cook lasagna noodles in the same boiling water until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain.
4. Mix spinach, ricotta, ½ cup mozzarella, egg, nutmeg, basil, salt, and pepper in a bowl until well combined.
5. Spread ¼ cup pasta sauce in the bottom of the dish. Top with 3 noodles, half the ricotta mixture, and ¼ cup sauce. Repeat with 3 more noodles, remaining ricotta mixture, and ¼ cup sauce. Finish with the last 3 noodles and ¼ cup sauce. Sprinkle with remaining ½ cup mozzarella, then Parmesan. Cover with foil.
6. Bake 25 minutes covered, then uncover and bake until bubbling and lightly browned, about 25 more minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

**Note on criteria:** This recipe has 117 ratings (Allrecipes' "reviews" count shown in search results) at 4.6 stars and is written for exactly 6 servings, so it fits all requirements. If you count only written text reviews (85), the closest alternative for 6 servings with ≥4.5 stars is "Baked Spaghetti Squash Lasagna-Style" (4.5 stars, 567 ratings, 427 reviews, 6 servings, vegetarian), though it uses spaghetti squash rather than lasagna noodles. Other highly rated vegetarian lasagnas (e.g., Vegetarian Four Cheese Lasagna, 4.6 stars, 243 ratings/170 reviews) serve 8 rather than 6.
